title: My client's sales dropped. Claude found out why.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Claude. My client's sales dropped forty percent this month.
beats.tts: [stressed, urgent] Claude. My client's sales dropped forty percent this month.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Ouch. What changed on the site?
beats.tts: [wincing] Ouch. [curious] What changed on the site?

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: No idea! I manage twelve websites. I can't check them all, every day.
beats.tts: [frustrated] No idea! I manage twelve websites. I can't check them all, every day!

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: So your strategy is... hope?
beats.tts: [deadpan] So your strategy is... [beat] hope?

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: It's worked so far.
beats.tts: [defensive, mumbling] It's worked so far.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Has it? If the contact page broke tonight, when would you know?
beats.tts: [playfully] Has it? [sharp] If the contact page broke tonight... when would you know?

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: When he calls me. Screaming.
beats.tts: [realizing, nervous laugh] When he calls me. [groans] Screaming.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Exactly. Okay, let me show you MyKavo.
beats.tts: [laughs] Exactly. [excited] Okay, let me show you MyKavo!
beats.title: Meet MyKavo

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: It audits every page of your site and gives it a health score.
beats.tts: [confident] It audits every page of your site, and gives it a health score.
beats.title: 1. Full site audit

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Wait. So it tells me what's wrong?
beats.tts: [intrigued] Wait. So it tells me what's wrong?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Better. It tells you what each problem is costing you. Visitors. Sales. Trust.
beats.tts: [smug] Better. It tells you what each problem is costing you. [emphatic] Visitors. Sales. Trust.
beats.title: 2. What it costs you

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Look. No contact page. No privacy policy. Heavy code slowing every page.
beats.tts: [pointing it out] Look. No contact page. No privacy policy. Heavy code slowing every page.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: That's literally my client's site.
beats.tts: [stunned] That's... literally my client's site.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: And that's why buyers leave.
beats.tts: [gently roasting] And that's why buyers leave.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: It even checks if AI can reach your site. If not, you're invisible in AI answers.
beats.tts: [leaning in, secretive] It even checks if AI can reach your site. If not... you're invisible in AI answers.
beats.title: 3. AI search check

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Okay, but I'm not a developer.
beats.tts: [hesitant] Okay, but... I'm not a developer.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: You don't need to be. AI explains every issue in plain English. And how to fix it.
beats.tts: [warm, reassuring] You don't need to be. AI explains every issue in plain English. And how to fix it.
beats.title: 4. AI fix guides

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: And it watches all twelve sites, 24/7. Broken link? Missing button? You know first.
beats.tts: [energetic] And it watches all twelve sites, twenty-four seven. Broken link? Missing button? [satisfied] You know first.
beats.title: 5. 24/7 monitoring

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Even WordPress? Custom sites?
beats.tts: [curious] Even WordPress? Custom sites?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Any website. Plus a report in your inbox every weekend.
beats.tts: [cheerful] Any website! Plus, a report in your inbox every weekend.
beats.title: 6. Weekly email report

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Okay, okay. How much does this cost?
beats.tts: [suspicious] Okay, okay. How much does this cost?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: It's free.
beats.tts: [casually] It's free.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Wait. Free free?
beats.tts: [shocked, disbelieving] Wait. Free... free?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Yes! Absolutely free.
beats.tts: [laughs, excited] Yes! Absolutely free!
beats.title: 100% FREE

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: I'm adding all twelve sites. Right now.
beats.tts: [hyped] I'm adding all twelve sites. Right now!

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Good. Start with that contact page. Before he calls again.
beats.tts: [teasing] Good. Start with that contact page. [laughs] Before he calls again.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: He's calling. Right now.
beats.tts: [panicked whisper] He's calling. Right now.
